title: Employ staff under the Joinery and Building Trades Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Joinery and Building Trades Award 2020.

sources.title: Joinery and Building Trades Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This award covers employers throughout Australia of employees in the joinery and building trades industries and occupations who are covered by the classifications in this award and those employees.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Joinery and Building Trades Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Joinery and building trades industries and occupations means: (a) the following industries: (i) joinery work; (ii) shopfitting; (iii) prefabricated building; (iv) stonemasonry; (v) glass and glazing contracting; and (vi) glass and glazing work. (b) the following occupations: (i) carver; (ii) letter cutter; (iii) carpenter; (iv) joiner; (v) signwriter; (vi) painter; (vii) stonemason; and (viii) plasterer.

sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Joinery and Building Trades Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
